description: Produces a S32 Configuration Tools Pins-tool .mex from a board description (schematic PDF or explicit routings list) plus an MCU/RTD/package triple. Triggers on "configure pins for board X", "generate Pins .mex from schematic", "route SPI/UART/CAN/LIN/ADC/PWM for evaluation board", "S32CT Pins .mex bring-up", "board-tailored pin routing", "auto-route peripherals from this schematic". Canonical entry point when the inputs are (a board) + (a peripheral wish-list or routings) + (MCU/RTD/package). Chains s32ct-pins-info to enumerate legal routings, s32ct-generate-mex-config to clone a reference .mex template and patch in the <pin> block, then s32ct-pins-facade -ShowProblems to validate with stderr capture.
